item.title: Communication
item.description: First of all, I want to say that no one is perfect. Everyone has their own weaknesses and flaws—even the moon has spots! Here, I’m talking about myself. Communication is the first area where I struggle. I’m trying to improve how I converse with others, but I often hear responses like “I don’t get you,” or “What did you say?” When I hear such things, I fall into deep distress. Sometimes I even feel worthless.
